title.en: Restore the Play language picker and target-language continuity
title.zh: 恢复 Play 语言选择器与目标语言连续性

purpose.en: Repair the production Play hub found during the 2026-08-27 real-user recovery run so its twelve-language picker is visible below all six activity tiles and one selected target language is preserved across every language-dependent entry.
purpose.zh: 修复 2026-08-27 真实用户恢复验收发现的生产 Play 中心缺陷：在六个活动卡片下方显示十二语言选择器，并让所有依赖语言的入口保持同一个目标语言。

en: Render the existing shared twelve-language picker below all six Play activity tiles and visibly mark the selected language.
Carry the selected target language into Today’s Sprint, SmartCard Practice, SmartCard Challenge, Rankings, and Free Trial without changing the Chinese interface locale.
zh: 在全部六个 Play 活动卡片下方渲染既有共享十二语言选择器，并清楚标记当前选择。
将所选目标语言传入今日速成、智慧卡练习、智慧卡挑战、排行榜和免费试学，同时保持中文界面语言不变。

en: The localized /{lang}/play hub and its links to /{lang}/smartcards, /{lang}/play/challenge, /{lang}/play/rankings, Sprint, and Free Trial.
No database schema, learning score, payment, referral, certificate, membership, authentication, or other site is changed.
zh: 涉及本地化 /{lang}/play 中心，以及通往 /{lang}/smartcards、/{lang}/play/challenge、/{lang}/play/rankings、Sprint 和免费试学的入口。
本次不修改数据库结构、学习成绩、付款、推荐、证书、会员、身份认证或其他站点。

en: Validate the language query against SmartLingo’s canonical twelve-language catalog before using it as the Play selection.
Generate the three link-based activity URLs through one behavior-tested helper and pass the same valid selection into both dialog-based activities.
Update bilingual Play guidance and activity copy to explain that the chosen target language stays consistent.
zh: 先按 SmartLingo 权威十二语言目录验证 language 查询参数，再将其用作 Play 当前选择。
通过一个行为测试覆盖的共享函数生成三个链接型活动网址，并把同一有效选择传给两个弹窗型活动。
更新双语 Play 指引与活动文案，说明所选目标语言会保持一致。

en: Require regression tests for selected and unselected activity URL mappings, picker placement after all six tiles, and selected-language handoff into Sprint and Free Trial.

Require the sentence catalog and 21-day QA contracts, shared portfolio policy and architecture gates, zero-warning lint, TypeScript, D1 migration validation, sensitive-data scan, full repository tests, verified build, and artifact checks.

After deployment, repeat the exact real-Chrome /zh/play?language=en step and verify the twelve choices, six tiles, target-language URLs, and Chinese interface before resuming daily learning acceptance.
zh: 要求回归测试覆盖已选与未选语言的活动网址映射、选择器位于六个卡片之后，以及所选语言传入 Sprint 与免费试学。
要求句库与 21 天 QA 合同、共享站点策略和架构门禁、零告警 lint、TypeScript、D1 迁移验证、敏感数据扫描、全仓库测试、验证构建和产物检查通过。
部署后在真实 Chrome 重复原始 /zh/play?language=en 步骤，核验十二个选择、六个卡片、目标语言网址和中文界面，再继续每日学习验收。

en: This focused release does not alter or directly write any learner score, progress, reward, challenge, leaderboard, payment, referral, or certificate record.
Microphone permission remains outside the scheduled QA flow; repeat-after-me stays off.
zh: 本次聚焦修复不修改或直接写入任何学习者成绩、进度、奖励、挑战、排行榜、付款、推荐或证书记录。
麦克风权限仍不属于定时 QA 流程；跟读保持关闭。

en: Reuse SmartLingo’s existing GameLanguagePicker and canonical language community catalog rather than introducing a second language taxonomy.
Preserve the SmartLingo Play card design, Chinese locale routes, official course IDs, server-graded learning flows, and independent Redeem destination.
zh: 复用 SmartLingo 既有 GameLanguagePicker 与权威语言社区目录，不引入第二套语言分类。
保留 SmartLingo Play 卡片设计、中文界面路由、官方课程编号、服务器评分学习流程和独立兑换入口。
